questions.en: How many cosmonauts did the Soviet Union send to the Moon before its collapse in 1991?

timeline.labelEn: Soviet crewed lunar programme, from the 1964 landing decision until it was cancelled
timeline.labelDe: Sowjetisches bemanntes Mondprogramm, vom Landungsbeschluss 1964 bis zur Einstellung

questions.notes: The crewed lunar flights were cancelled and the N1-L3 landing project ended in 1974; no Soviet cosmonaut ever flew to the Moon.

questions.en: Which word, meaning “shaded” in French, describes the gradation of a colour from light to dark?

timeline.labelEn: German borrows “Nuance” from French nuance (shading, colour gradation)
timeline.labelDe: Das Deutsche entlehnt „Nuance“ aus dem französischen nuance (Schattierung, Farbabstufung)

questions.notes: French nuance = „Schattierung; Abstufung“ (from nuer, to shade). Borrowed into German in the mid-18th century (de.wiktionary, after DWDS).

questions.cardDe: Nach wem sind ein Mondkrater und eine Meeresströmung benannt: Alexander von Humboldt, Marco Polo oder Robert Koch?
questions.de: Nach welchem Naturforscher sind ein Mondmeer und eine kalte Meeresströmung vor Südamerika benannt?
questions.en: Which naturalist are a lunar mare and a cold ocean current off South America named after?

timeline.labelEn: Alexander von Humboldt, Prussian naturalist and explorer
timeline.labelDe: Alexander von Humboldt, preußischer Naturforscher und Forschungsreisender

questions.notes: Card says 'Mondkrater': the lunar crater Humboldt is actually named after his brother Wilhelm; Alexander's lunar feature is the Mare Humboldtianum (IAU 1935). Hence reworded to 'Mondmeer'. The Humboldt Current is named after Alexander.

questions.cardDe: Was soll laut einer US-Studie der Yale-Universität von 2016 das Leben verlängern: Bücher lesen, Bilder malen oder für Freunde kochen?
questions.de: Welche Freizeitbeschäftigung soll laut einer US-Studie der Yale-Universität von 2016 das Leben verlängern?
questions.en: According to a 2016 US study by Yale University, which leisure activity is said to prolong life?

timeline.labelEn: Yale study “A Chapter a Day” links book reading with longer life
timeline.labelDe: Yale-Studie „A Chapter a Day“ verbindet Bücherlesen mit längerem Leben

source.title: Do book lovers live longer? (Christian Science Monitor)

questions.notes: Social Science & Medicine, 2016: 3,635 adults over 50 followed 12 years; book readers had about 20% lower mortality (association, not proven cause). Newspapers/magazines showed no such effect.
